name: Liberty Science Center Open 2017

venue.name: [Liberty Science Center](http://www.lsc.org/)
venue.address: 222 Jersey City Blvd, Jersey City, New Jersey 07305

information:
The registration fee is $30 and includes admission into the science center. There is  a maximum of 120 competitors for this competition. Pre-registration and pre-payment is required to compete. Walk-ins will not be permitted to compete and there will be no waitlist for this competition--once the competitor limit is reached, registration will be closed. Spectators will need to purchase tickets for admission to the science center. Ticket information is available at [LSC's website](https://lsc.org/buy-tickets), but tickets may be purchased on-site.

This is a CubingUSA supported competition.
